task_description:
Prepare the address book for emergency readiness and clean up duplicates:

   - From the duplicate record, add the extra phone number +1-310-555-6677 to the primary.

2) Create a new category “Emergency Contacts” with description “Critical contacts to reach in urgent situations.” Assign this category to:
